title: Number of Dice Rolls With Target Sum
summary: Determine the number of ways to roll n dice, each with k faces, such that the sum of the faces equals the target, modulo 10^9 + 7.
statement: Determine the number of ways to roll n dice, each with k faces, such that the sum of the faces equals the target, modulo 10^9 + 7.
constraints: Each die has faces 1 through k.
hints: Let dp[sum] count ways after the dice processed so far.
Begin with one way to make zero using no dice.
For each die, add every face value into a fresh table, reducing modulo the required constant.
Each ordered roll sequence follows exactly one transition path, so the final target cell is exact.
